key_findings.note: Published 10 August 2024; volume 241, page 2403; issue date November 2024; original published 21 November 2020; cited as Psychopharmacology (2020) 238:581-588, doi 10.1007/s00213-020-05710-w.

Two of the authors are named as affiliated with MAPS PBC (the affiliations list Jerome and Mithoefer there). Small wording point: the notice says MAPS 'fully funded and provided the MDMA that was used in this trial', which leaves open what was funded; the card's 'fully funded the trial and provided the MDMA' (here and in the funding field) is the BMJ's reading, not the notice's words. The two other notice cards keep the notice's construction.
All four authors responded; three disagree.
